book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: Bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔkurɑ yiru yen yĩsɑ
Yesu u win bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔkurɑ yiru mɛnnɑ mɑ u bu yiiko wɛ̃ bu kɑ wɛrɛkunu ɡirɑ, kpɑ bu bɑrɑru kɑ wɑsin dɑm sɑriru bɑɑtere bɛkiɑ.
Bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔkurɑ yiru yen yĩsɑ wee. Gbiikoo Simɔɔ wi bɑ rɑ soku Piɛɛ kɑ win wɔnɔ Andere, kɑ Yɑkɔbu kɑ win wɔnɔ Yohɑnu, Sebeden bibu,
kɑ Filipu kɑ Bɑɑtelemi kɑ Tomɑɑ kɑ Mɑteu wi u rɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡbere mwɑɔ, kɑ Yɑkɔbu Alufen bii kɑ Tɑde,
kɑ Simɔɔ wi u win tem ɡɑri kĩ, kɑ Yudɑsi Isikɑriɔtu wi u tɔmbu Yesu nɔmu sɔndiɑ.
Yesu u bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔkurɑ yiru ɡɔrɑ
Yesu u tɔmbu wɔkurɑ yiru ye ɡɔrɑ kɑ woodɑ yeni u nɛɛ, i ku swɑɑ ɡɑɑ swĩi ye yɑ dɔɔ tɔn tukobun tem ɡiɑ, i ku mɑɑ Sɑmɑriɡibun wuu ɡɑɡu du.
Adɑmɑ i doo Isirelibɑn mi, be bɑ kɔ̃ɔrɑ nɡe yɑ̃ɑnu.
I doo i kpɑrɑ i nɛɛ, Gusunɔ u sisi u bɑndu swĩi.
I bɑrɔbu bɛkio, i ɡɔribu seeyo, i be bɑ bɑrɑ disiɡiru mɔ bɛkio bu dɛɛrɑ, kpɑ i wɛrɛkunu ɡirɑ tɔmbun wɑsi sɔɔn di. Yèn sɔ̃ i wɑ kɔsiɑru sɑri, i mɑɑ wɛ̃ɛyɔ n kun kɑ kɔsiɑru.
I ku dukiɑ ɡɑɑ suɑ i kɑ dɑ, nɡe wurɑ ǹ kun mɛ sii ɡeesu, ǹ kun mɛ sii ɡɑndu bɛɛn bɔɔrɔ.
I ku kɑ yɑ̃ɑ kureru dɑ, ǹ kun mɛ yɑberu yiruse, ǹ kun mɛ bɑrɑnu ǹ kun mɛ dɛkɑ. N weenɛ bu sɔm kowo wɛ̃ yèn bukɑtɑ u mɔ u n kɑ wɑ̃ɑ.
Ì n turɑ wuu mɑroɔ ǹ kun mɛ wuu piibu sɔɔ, i de i mɛɛri wi u weenɛ u bɛɛ dɑm koosiɑ, kpɑ i sinɑ win yɛnuɔ sere i kɑ sĩ wuu ɡen min di.
Ì n yɛnu ɡɑɡu duɑ i ɡen tɔmbu tɔbirio kpɑ i nɛɛ, Gusunɔ u bɛɛ ɑlɑfiɑ kɛ̃.
Yɛnu ɡeɡibu bɑ̀ n kɑ ɑlɑfiɑ ye weenɛ, i de yɑ n wɑ̃ɑ be sɔɔ, ɑdɑmɑ bɑ̀ kun kɑ weenɛ, i de yu wurɑmɑ bɛɛn mi.
Wuu ɡɑɡu ǹ kun mɛ yɛnu ɡɑɡun tɔmbu bɑ̀ n mɑɑ yinɑ bu bɛɛ dɑm koosiɑ, bu sere bɛɛn ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑki, i doonɔ min di kpɑ i bɛɛn nɑɑsun tuɑ bu kpɑre.
Kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, siribun sɑnɑm Gusunɔ u koo Sodomu kɑ Gomɔrɑɡibu wɔnwɔndu sɔ̃ɔsi n kere wuu ɡen tɔmbu.
Nɔni swɑ̃ɑru te tɑ sisi
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, wee, nɑ bɛɛ ɡɔrimɔ nɡe yɑ̃ɑnu dɛmɑkunun suunu sɔɔ. I de i n bwisi mɔ nɡe wɛɛ, kpɑ i n kɑ kpɑrukonu weenɛ tɑki sɑriru sɔɔ.
I lɑɑkɑri koowo domi ɡɑbɑ koo bɛɛ mwɑ bu kɑ dɑ siri yerɔ, kpɑ bu bɛɛ sɛni so ben mɛnnɔ yenɔ.
Bɑ koo bɛɛ siri tem yɛ̃robu kɑ sinɑmbun wuswɑɑɔ nɛn sɔ̃, kpɑ i kɑ seedɑ di ben mi kɑ tɔn tukobun mi.
Bɑ̀ n kɑ bɛɛ dɑ siri yerɔ, i ku wururɑ kɑ ɡɑri yi i ko ɡere. I ku mɑɑ wururɑ nɡe mɛ i ko ɡerusinɑ. Sɑɑ ye, yɑ̀ n turɑ, i ko wɑ ɡɑri yi i ko ɡere.
Domi ɡɑri yi i ko ɡere yi ǹ ko n sɑ̃ɑ bɛɛɡii, yi koo nɑwɑ sɑɑ bɛɛn Bɑɑbɑn Hunden min di wi u wɑ̃ɑ bɛɛ sɔɔ.
Gɑbɑ koo ben wɔnɔbu ǹ kun mɛ ben mɑɑbu sɔ̃ɔsi bu kɑ bu ɡo. Bɑɑbɑbɑ bɑ ko mɑɑ ko mɛ ben bibu sɔɔ, mɑ bibu bɑ koo ben mɔwɔbu kɔrumɔtɔnu kuɑ bu kɑ bu ɡo.
Bɑɑwure u koo bɛɛ tusi nɛn yĩsirun sɔ̃. Adɑmɑ wi u tɛmɑnɑ sere kɑ nɔrɔ u koo fɑɑbɑ wɑ.
Bɑ̀ n bɛɛ nɔni sɔ̃ɔwɑ wuu teu sɔɔ, i duki doonɔ wuu ɡɑɡun mi. Nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ kɑ ɡem, i ǹ ko i Isirelin wusu kpuro sɑsiri i kpe, Tɔnun Bii u kɑ tunumɑ.
Mɛɛro sɑri wi u win sɔ̃ɔsio kere. Yoo mɑɑ sɑri wi u win yinni kere.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, n turɑ mɛɛro u kɑ win sɔ̃ɔsio weenɑ kpɑ yoo u kɑ win yinni weenɑ. Bɑ̀ n yɛnu yɛ̃ro sokumɔ Beseburu, bɑ koo win yɛnuɡibu yĩsi kɔ̃sunu kɛ̃ n kere wi.
Wìn bɛrum n weenɛ i ko
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, yen sɔ̃, i ku ben bɛrum ko, domi ye yɑ wukiri yɑ koo terɑ, yen ɑsirin ɡɑ̃ɑnu mɑɑ sɑri ni bɑ ǹ koo ɡiɑ.
Ye nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ yɑm wɔ̃kuru sɔɔ, i ye ɡeruo yɑm bururɑm sɔɔ. Ye i mɑɑ nuɑ ɑsiri sɔɔ, i yɔɔwo ɡidɑmbisɑ wɔllɔ i kɑ ye kpuro kpɑrɑ.
I ku bu nɑsiɑ be bɑ koo wɑsi tɔnɑ ɡo, be bɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ bu hunde ɡo. Adɑmɑ i yɛ̃ro nɑsio wi u koo kpĩ u wɑsi kɑ hunde ɡo sɑnnu dɔ̃ɔ wi u ku rɑ ɡbi sɔɔ.
I ǹ ko kpĩ i ɡunɔminu yiru dwe kɑ fɑrɑm? Kɑ mɛ, bɑɑ nin teu, ɡɑ ǹ koo wɔrumɑ temɔ mɑ n kun mɔ bɛɛn Bɑɑbɑ u wurɑ.
Bɛɛ mɑɑ, bɑ mɑm bɛɛn wirun serin ɡeeru yɛ̃.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, i ku bɛrum ko, i ɡunɔminu bɛɛrɛ kere sere mi n tomɑ.
Wi u Kirisi wurɑ
tɔmbun wuswɑɑɔ
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, bɑɑwure wi u mɑn wurɑ tɔmbun wuswɑɑɔ, kon mɑɑ yɛ̃ro wurɑ nɛn Bɑɑbɑn wuswɑɑɔ wi u wɑ̃ɑ wɔllɔ.
Adɑmɑ wi u mɑn yinɑ tɔmbun wuswɑɑɔ, kon mɑɑ yɛ̃ro yinɑ nɛn Bɑɑbɑn wuswɑɑɔ wi u wɑ̃ɑ wɔllɔ.
Alɑfiɑ kɑ tɑkobin ɡɑri
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, i kun tɑmɑɑ nɑ nɑwɑ hɑnduniɑɔ n kɑ ɑlɑfiɑ wɛ̃, ɑɑwo, tɑkobiwɑ nɑ kɑ nɑ.
Nɑ nɑwɑ n kɑ sɑnnɔ doke bii tɔn durɔ kɑ win tundon suunu sɔɔ, kɑ mɑɑ bii tɔn kurɔ kɑ win mɛron suunu sɔɔ, kɑ mɑɑ kurɔ mɔro kɑ win dwɑɑ mɛron suunu sɔɔ.
Tɔnun yɛnuɡibu beyɑ bɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑ win yibɛrɛbɑ.
Wi u win tundo ǹ kun mɛ win mɛro kĩ n mɑn kere u ǹ turɑ u n kɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛɡii. Nɡe mɛyɑ wi u win bii kĩ n mɑn kere u ǹ turɑ u n kɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛɡii.
Mɑ wi u kun win dɑ̃ɑ bunɑnɑru sue u n kɑ mɑn swĩi u ǹ turɑ u n kɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛɡii.
Wi u kĩ u win wɑ̃ɑru di kɑ win ɡɔ̃ru kĩru u koo tu biɑ. Adɑmɑ wi u win wɑ̃ɑru yinɑ nɛn sɔ̃ u koo tu wɑ kɑ ɡem.
Aren ɡɑri
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, wi u bɛɛ dɑm koosiɑ nɛnɑ u dɑm koosiɑ. Wi u mɑɑ mɑn dɑm koosiɑ, u wi u mɑn ɡɔrimɑ dɑm koosiɑwɑ.
Wi u Gusunɔn sɔmɔ dɑm koosiɑ yèn sɔ̃ u sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ, u koo ɑre wɑ nɡe Gusunɔn sɔmɔɡii. Wi u mɑɑ tɔn ɡeo dɑm koosiɑ, yèn sɔ̃ u sɑ̃ɑ tɔn ɡeo, u koo ɑre wɑ nɡe tɔn ɡeoɡii.
Wi u bwɛ̃ɛbwɛ̃ɛ benin turo ɡɑ̃ɑnu kɑ̃ yèn sɔ̃ u sɑ̃ɑ nɛn bɔ̃ɔ, bɑɑ ǹ n nim nɔrurɑm nɑ, nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ kɑ ɡem, yɛ̃ro kun win ɑre biɑmɔ.
